set -e; git checkout -q -b 55-image-processor; git add src docs; git commit -q -m "feat: give pi-durable extensions an image processor" -m "Extensions get images: createNodePhotonImages() in their host options, so pit
resizes and converts what workspace.viewImage attaches to the model's limits." 2>&1 | grep -E "Failed|✖" || true; git log -1 --format=%B; git push -q -u origin 55-image-processor 2>&1 | grep -v remote || true; gh pr create --title "feat: give pi-durable extensions an image processor" --body "Refs #55.

pit 0.36.2 takes an \`images\` option, an \`ImageProcessor\`, for \`workspace.viewImage\` on pi-durable hosts (cv/pit#365). Without one, pit attaches PNG, JPEG, GIF, and WebP images within the byte limit as they are, and rejects larger ones.

- \`createDurableExtensions\` creates one \`createNodePhotonImages()\` processor of pi-durable and passes it to every extension as \`images\` in the host options. Its worker thread starts with the first image and exits when idle.
- \`DurableHostOptions\` has the new \`images\` member; the tests check that every extension gets the same processor.
- `docs/extensions.md`: the host options table lists \`images\`.

pi-action's own \`read\` (\`CodingTools\`) still has no processor; that is unchanged here.

\`npm run check\` passes."
